title: Uganda lower secondary competency-based curriculum
subject: NCDC curriculum framework
summary: The National Curriculum Development Centre describes a competency-based framework built around key learning outcomes, values, generic skills, cross-cutting issues and a curriculum menu. Use the learner-selected subject syllabus and local school context to check alignment.

title: Community inquiry and environmental action
subject: Integrated Science and Agriculture
summary: Investigate local soil, water, crops, waste or energy needs through observation and respectful community interviews. Compare practical options, use locally available resources, and test prototypes safely with teacher guidance.

title: Numeracy, communication and entrepreneurship in projects
subject: Mathematics, English and Entrepreneurship
summary: Learners can collect and represent community data, explain findings orally or in writing, work collaboratively, cost a small solution, and share results with the people affected. Adapt language and complexity to the learner's level and school syllabus.

title: Inclusive foundational literacy
subject: Local languages and literacy
summary: Use age-appropriate oral discussion, drawing, labels, simple observation records and presentation. For younger learners, follow the school's language of instruction and foundational literacy guidance; consult local educators for language and accessibility needs.
